Subscription and Renewal

  • Renewal pricing uses the stated renewal basis and uplift. Any approved uplift applies to eligible recurring lines.

  • Upsells, downsells and swaps are documented through an amendment. A downsell recalculates the eligible quantity tier and related volume discount.
